name: Jeffrey S. Levinger
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Dallas, Texas

about: Jeffrey S. Levinger is an attorney providing legal services covering Appellate and Business Litigation.

Jeffrey Levinger, who practices law in Dallas, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Virginia School of Law. He graduated in 1982. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1982.
